rules.title: Relocation assistance for owner move-in evictions
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quote: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.summary: Owners must pay relocation assistance to tenants when evicting them for owner move-in, with a standard payment of $19,413 and an additional $6,471 for qualifying households (effective January 1, 2026).
rules.effective_date_evidence: the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026

rules.title: Relocation assistance for Ellis Act evictions
rules.quote: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.summary: Owners must pay relocation assistance to tenants when removing a property from the rental market under the Ellis Act, with a standard payment of $19,413 and an additional $6,471 for qualifying households (effective January 1, 2026).
rules.effective_date_evidence: the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026
